model_sql: SELECT p.product_name, c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS order_count FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, p.product_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 1;

SELECT c.city, AVG(order_total) AS avg_order_value FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS order_total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC;

SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS distinct_customers FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY distinct_customers DESC;

SELECT w.warehouse_name, SUM(p.price * i.quantity) AS total_inventory_value FROM warehouses w JOIN inventory i ON w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY w.warehouse_name ORDER BY total_inventory_value DESC;
SELECT DISTINCT e.first_name, e.last_name FROM employees e JOIN orders o ON e.employee_id = o.handled_by JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.city = 'Berlin';

SELECT w.warehouse_name, 
       MAX_stock.product_name AS most_stocked_product, MAX_stock.max_quantity, 
       MIN_stock.product_name AS least_stocked_product, MIN_stock.min_quantity
FROM warehouses w
JOIN (
    SELECT i.warehouse_id, p.product_name, i.quantity AS max_quantity
    FROM inventory i
    JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN (
        SELECT warehouse_id, MAX(quantity) AS max_qty
        FROM inventory
        GROUP BY warehouse_id
    ) max_qtys ON i.warehouse_id = max_qtys.warehouse_id AND i.quantity = max_qtys.max_qty
) AS MAX_stock ON w.warehouse_id = MAX_stock.warehouse_id
JOIN (
    SELECT i.warehouse_id, p.product_name, i.quantity AS min_quantity
    FROM inventory i
    JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN (
        SELECT warehouse_id, MIN(quantity) AS min_qty
        FROM inventory
        GROUP BY warehouse_id
    ) min_qtys ON i.warehouse_id = min_qtys.warehouse_id AND i.quantity = min_qtys.min_qty
) AS MIN_stock ON w.warehouse_id = MIN_stock.warehouse_id
ORDER BY w.warehouse_name;
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS order_month, status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE YEAR(order_date) = 2025 GROUP BY order_month, status ORDER BY order_month, status;

SELECT c.category_name, AVG(oi.unit_price) AS avg_unit_price FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY avg_unit_price DESC;
SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customers c WHERE c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT o.customer_id FROM orders o WHERE o.status = 'cancelled');

SELECT p.product_name, IFNULL(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS total_ordered_quantity FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY total_ordered_quantity DESC;

SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_spent 
FROM customers c 
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id 
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id 
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id 
WHERE p.price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products) 
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name 
ORDER BY total_spent DESC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.department_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_order_value FROM departments d JOIN employees e ON d.department_id = e.department_id JOIN orders o ON e.employee_id = o.handled_by JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY d.department_name ORDER BY total_order_value DESC;

SELECT p.product_name FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.product_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory i WHERE i.product_id = p.product_id AND i.quantity > 0);

SELECT c.category_name, (SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) / (SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price) FROM order_items)) * 100 AS revenue_percentage FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY revenue_percentage DESC;

SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS order_value
FROM orders o
JOIN employees e ON o.handled_by = e.employee_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY o.order_id, e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name
ORDER BY order_value DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT e.first_name AS employee_first_name, e.last_name AS employee_last_name, m.first_name AS manager_first_name, m.last_name AS manager_last_name, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 0) AS total_handled_value FROM employees e LEFT JOIN employees m ON e.manager_id = m.employee_id LEFT JOIN orders o ON e.employee_id = o.handled_by LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, m.first_name, m.last_name ORDER BY total_handled_value DESC;

SELECT c.category_name
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
JOIN inventory i ON p.product_id = i.product_id
JOIN warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN w.city = 'Berlin' THEN i.quantity ELSE 0 END) > 0.5 * SUM(i.quantity);

SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC) AS spend_rank FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

SELECT o.order_id
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY o.order_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.category_id) > 3;

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS order_month, 
       SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_order_value,
       LAG(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price)) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m')) AS previous_month_value,
       CASE 
         WHEN LAG(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price)) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m')) IS NULL THEN NULL
         ELSE (SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) - LAG(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price)) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m'))) / LAG(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price)) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m')) * 100
       END AS month_over_month_growth_percentage
FROM orders o 
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY order_month
ORDER BY order_month;
